files.README.md:
# Harrowfen Mill Supplies - dispatch note delivery

Dispatch notes are generated per order and handed to the visitor's browser through a
front-end cache layer that fronts the note service.
The rules the delivery team settled on are written up in headers/response-header-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Harrowfen Mill Supplies hands each dispatch note to a front-end cache layer before the note reaches the visitor's browser. Give the response header line that tells that cache, and every other cache in the chain, that no copy of the note may be written to storage at all. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
